title: Kartu Hak Milik
subject: A Medan man who has lost every game of Monopoli to his younger sister for twenty years hides a stolen property card in his sock for the rematch, then sees three cards fall out of her sock too
caption: Indonesian 1970s hard rock in the style of early Indonesian stadium rock. An overdriven electric guitar plays a heavy blues-based riff, a Hammond organ with Leslie swirl doubles it and fills the gaps, a fat bass guitar locks with a loud acoustic drum kit playing a driving straight beat, a short guitar solo in the middle. Vintage tape saturation, roomy live drum sound. A male lead sings with a raw gritty rock voice, clearly sung with strong open vowels. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 138 BPM, E minor. Loud, mischievous mood. No electronic beats, no autotune, no rap, no synth pop, no screamed vocals, no heavy metal double-kick.
lyrics:
[Intro - fuzz guitar riff, Hammond organ]

[Verse 1]
Minggu sore, papan terbentang di lantai
Rina pegang semua hotel di Jalan Malioboro
Uangku tinggal tiga lembar mainan
Dan satu kartu terselip di kaus kaki

[Pre-Chorus]
Dua puluh tahun aku kalah
Hari ini giliranku, hari ini

[Chorus]
Bayar sewa, Rina, bayar sewa
Aku punya Malioboro, hotel di atasnya
Jangan lirik kaus kakiku
Hari ini aku yang menang

[Verse 2]
Rina diam, lalu mengangkat kakinya
Dari kaus kakinya jatuh tiga kartu
Dua puluh tahun, Bang, katanya tertawa
Dua puluh tahun aku juga curang

[Chorus]
Bayar sewa, Bang, kita sama
Dua kaus kaki, dua tukang bohong
Ayo kocok dadu sekali lagi
Siapa yang jujur, dia yang kalah

[Outro - guitar riff, organ]
Kocok dadunya, kocok dadunya
Siapa yang jujur, dia yang kalah
